name: bilingual_AI_prompt_library
description: A practical, bilingual AI prompt library designed for prompt engineering across work, learning, content creation, marketing, and everyday applications.

inputs.name: task_description
inputs.description: Description of the task or scenario needing an AI prompt.

inputs.name: language_preference
inputs.description: Specifies the desired language for the prompt output (e.g., English, Chinese).

inputs.name: context_data
inputs.description: Optional contextual information to enrich the generated prompt.

outputs.name: ai_prompt
outputs.description: Generated bilingual AI prompt tailored for the specified task and language.

outputs.name: prompt_templates
outputs.description: A collection of reusable bilingual prompt templates for various common use cases.

patterns: Bilingual prompt formulation combining Chinese and English
Task-specific prompt template reuse and customization
Prompt categorization for work, learning, marketing, content creation, and daily use
steps: Identify the target task or application domain for the AI prompt.
Select or input the desired language preference for prompt output.
Provide additional context or details if needed to refine the prompt.
Retrieve or generate an appropriate bilingual prompt template based on inputs.
Customize the prompt template to fit the specific scenario.
Output the final bilingual AI prompt for use in AI interactions.
use_cases: Creating effective bilingual prompts for marketing campaigns
Generating language learning exercises or materials
Enhancing content creation with tailored AI prompts
Automating daily task prompts in both English and Chinese
Developing prompt engineering solutions for productivity tools

prompt_templates.name: general_task_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Please generate a response for the following task in {language_preference}: {task_description}

prompt_templates.name: marketing_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create an engaging marketing message in {language_preference} focusing on: {task_description}

prompt_templates.name: learning_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Design a learning activity in {language_preference} about: {task_description}

prompt_templates.name: daily_use_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Provide a helpful prompt in {language_preference} for the following everyday use scenario: {task_description}
